_comment: Custom rules example — shows how to write model-specific rules during triaging.
When --rule_config IS supplied, only the rules defined in this file run;
built-in rules are replaced entirely by whatever you list here.
Add, remove, or modify entries to match your model's quantization requirements.
description: Custom rules example for triaging quantization issues

validation_rules.name: embedding_weights_8bit_symmetric
validation_rules.description: Embedding weights must use 8-bit symmetric quantization

validation_rules.name: linear_weights_per_channel
validation_rules.description: Linear layer weights must use per-channel quantization (min 2 channels)

validation_rules.name: conv_weight_scale_range
validation_rules.description: Convolution weights must have scales in range [0.001, 0.1]

context_aware_rules.name: activation_offset_range
context_aware_rules.description: Activation tensor offsets must be in [-128, 127] (int8 range)
